text: 【央行：10月份银行间人民币市场同业拆借月加权平均利率为1.3%】央行数据显示，10月份银行间人民币市场以拆借、现券和回购方式合计成交167.98万亿元，日均成交9.33万亿元，日均成交同比增长1.9%。其中，同业拆借日均成交同比下降10.8%，现券日均成交同比增长4.7%，质押式回购日均成交同比增长1.3%。
text_en: [PBOC: October interbank RMB market weighted average monthly interbank lending rate was 1.3%] PBOC data shows that in October, total transactions in the interbank RMB market via lending, outright bonds and repo reached RMB 167.98 trillion, with average daily transactions of RMB 9.33 trillion, up 1.9% year on year on a daily average basis. Among them, average daily interbank lending transactions fell 10.8% year on year, average daily outright bond transactions rose 4.7% year on year, and average daily pledged repo transactions rose 1.3% year on year.
